about: Sample introduction front ends (headspace, purge and trap, laser ablation, pyrolysis, thermal desorption): method KEY=VALUE, load / unload vials, set-temp per zone, start (job), inject (manual pyrolyzer step), stop, result, position (laser stage), status. Ranges and units come from each member's contract.

membership.notes: power, open / close of lids, guards, drawers and shields come from the shared layer on every member.

load.label: no sequence running
load.message: {inst} is running a sequence; the tray is in use.
load.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

unload.label: no sequence running
unload.message: {inst} is running a sequence; the tray is in use.
unload.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

set-temp.label: power on
set-temp.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

set-temp.label: room temperature known
set-temp.message: {inst} does not know the room temperature yet, so it takes no zone set points (the lab sets it up).
set-temp.fix: ask the lab operator to set the instrument up; nothing to do from chemlab.

start.label: power on
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: equilibration time set
start.message: {inst} has no equilibration time in its method, so a sequence cannot start.
start.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method equilibration=10min`.

start.label: GC connected
start.message: {inst} is not connected to a GC, so it cannot inject.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to connect the GC.

start.label: lid closed
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid`.

stop.label: a sequence running
stop.fix: nothing to stop; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

sample.load:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} did not take that vial: the vial id is not one the lab prepared, or it is already in the tray.
sample.load:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: use a vial id the lab gave you; see the tray with `chemlab run {inst} status`.

thermal.set_temperature:PRECONDITION_FAI.message: {inst} refused the set point: it must be at least 5 K above the room temperature and the instrument must be on.
thermal.set_temperature:PRECONDITION_FAI.fix: give a higher set point; check `chemlab run {inst} status`.

sequence.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start a sequence: the method needs an equilibration time and the instrument must be idle.
sequence.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: set `chemlab run {inst} method equilibration=10min`; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

sequence.start:BUSY.message: {inst} is busy (a sequence, a test, a calibration or its start-up).

unsupported.inject: the 8697 injects only within a sequence (its direct `measure` path is a second native path the class does not use)
unsupported.position: no sample stage (vials move on the tray)
unsupported.rinse: no rinse step (the sample loop is purged by the method's purge settings)

alternatives.inject: run a one-vial sequence: `chemlab run INST start --vials N`.

start: the sequence waits until the oven is at temperature and the instrument is ready; the job ends when every vial is back in the tray
the GC runs belong to the GC; the lab connects it
set-temp: zones: oven (vials), loop (sample loop and valve), transfer (transfer line); set points at least 5 K above the room temperature
method: equilibration goes to the method's equilibration time; the other keys go to the headspace method (only what you give changes)

agilent_hs8697.manual: Agilent 8697 headspace operation manual G4511-90004 (method, tray, sequences, Park; see manifest key sections); 8697 brochure p.5-6 (method parameters)

examples.method: chemlab run INST method equilibration=10min gc-cycle=5min shake=3

method.label: no run in progress
method.message: {inst} is running; the method cannot change now.
method.fix: wait for the run (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

start.label: power on
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: method set
start.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method matrix=water purge-time=11min` (see `chemlab help {inst} method`).

start.label: guard closed
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close guard`.

start.label: trap door closed
start.message: the trap door of {inst} is open.
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close trap_door`.

start.label: a vial on the tray
start.message: there is no sample vial on the tray of {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to place the vials.

stop.label: a run in progress
stop.fix: nothing to stop; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

rinse.label: power on
rinse.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

rinse.label: no run in progress
rinse.message: {inst} is running; it rinses after the run by itself.
rinse.fix: wait for the run (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

acquisition.start:EMPTY_POSITION.message: there is no vial at that tray position of {inst}.
acquisition.start:EMPTY_POSITION.fix: give the position the lab put the vial at (`--vial N`).

acquisition.start:METHOD_MATRIX.message: the vial's matrix does not match the method's matrix on {inst}.
acquisition.start:METHOD_MATRIX.fix: set `chemlab run {inst} method matrix=...` to the sample's matrix.

acquisition.start:HOT_TRAP.message: the trap of {inst} is still hot from the last run.
acquisition.start:HOT_TRAP.fix: wait a few minutes, then start again.

method.configure:METHOD_GRID.message: {inst} takes times and temperatures only on its setting grid.

acquisition.start:NOT_READY.message: {inst} is not ready to take that vial: there is no vial at that tray position, or the sparge vessel still holds liquid from a stopped run.
acquisition.start:NOT_READY.fix: rinse it (`chemlab run {inst} rinse`), and check the tray position (`--vial N`).

unsupported.load: the vials are placed on the tray by the lab operator (no load command)
unsupported.unload: the vials are taken off the tray by the lab operator (no unload command)
unsupported.set-temp: its temperatures are method settings (purge-temp, desorb-temp, bake-temp)
unsupported.inject: the run transfers the sample by itself (no manual step)

start: --vial N is the tray position (1..84); the contract counts from 0, so position 1 is vial_index 0
one run takes about 20 min with the documented method; follow it with the job
method: method.configure needs every setting; the ones you leave out stay as in the last accepted method, else the documented defaults (the reply lists them)
rinse: water rinse of the sparger after a stopped or failed run; the default volume is the documented 7 mL; the trap is not cleaned by it

rinse.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method mode=spot` (see `chemlab help {inst} method`).

rinse.label: sample drawer closed

acquisition.start:SAMPLE_BOUNDS.message: the laser path of the method leaves the sample on {inst}.
acquisition.start:SAMPLE_BOUNDS.fix: set a path inside the sample (`chemlab run {inst} method path_m=[[x,y,z]]`, metres).

acquisition.start:GRID_RESOLUTION.message: the spot is too small for the sample model of {inst}.

method.configure:APERTURE_LIST_UNAVAILAB.message: {inst} knows only the 50 µm circle and the 80 µm square apertures.
method.configure:APERTURE_LIST_UNAVAILAB.fix: use `method shape=square spot=80um` or `shape=circle spot=50um`, or add accept_aperture_interpolation=true.

method.configure:PATH_INVALID.message: the laser path does not fit the mode (spot: one point, scan: two or more, z at most 50 mm).

unsupported.load: the sample is placed in the ablation cell drawer by the lab operator (no load command)
unsupported.unload: the sample is taken out of the drawer by the lab operator (no unload command)
unsupported.inject: the ablated aerosol goes to the ICP-MS by itself (no manual step)

start: the laser fires along the method's path; a spot of 10 shots takes about 2 s plus the washout
position: moves the stage (bare numbers in mm, the stage travel is 0..100 mm) and waits until it is there
method: fluence is in J/m² (60000 J/m² = 6 J/cm²); path_m is a JSON list of [x, y, z] points in metres
rinse: a gas washout of the ablation cell into the ICP-MS for the method's washout time (a job)

lower the sampler into the furnace

start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab call {inst} gas.set --enabled true`.

method.configure:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} takes temperatures in whole °C, times in 6 s steps and ramps in 1 K/min steps, the end temperature not below the start, and every temperature at least 10 K above the room.

cup.drop:MANUAL_INTERLOCK.message: {inst} does not take the cup now (the run is not waiting for the drop, the sampler is down or the GC is not ready).

unsupported.load: the sample cup is filled and put into the sampler by the lab operator (no load command)
unsupported.unload: the sample cup is taken out by the lab operator (no unload command)
unsupported.set-temp: its temperatures are method settings (pyrolysis-temp, td-start, td-end, interface-temp)
unsupported.rinse: no rinse step (the furnace is cleaned by heating, not by the agent)

start: the run heats the furnace and then waits for the manual step: use `chemlab run INST inject --wait` (single shot: the cup drop)
the GC must be ready (the lab runs it); the job ends when the furnace has cooled after the shot
inject: single shot: drop the cup and confirm; double shot / EGA: lower the sampler and confirm, later raise it and confirm

acquisition.start:NOT_READY.message: {inst} is not ready to start: in analyze mode it needs a sample tube loaded and a cool tube oven, and a method with recollect=true needs the re-collection tube installed.
acquisition.start:NOT_READY.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; set `method recollect=false` if no re-collection tube is installed.

method.configure:TENAX_TEMPERATURE_LIMIT.message: {inst} keeps the tube and the trap at or below 350 °C (sorbent limit).
method.configure:TENAX_TEMPERATURE_LIMIT.fix: give desorb-temp and trap-high of 350C or less.

method.configure:FLOW_RANGE.message: {inst} takes the purge, trap and split flows in whole mL/min from 2 to 500 mL/min (250 with nitrogen), or 0 for the splits.
method.configure:FLOW_RANGE.fix: round the flows to whole mL/min.

method.configure:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} takes temperatures in whole °C and times in 6 s steps, with trap-high not below trap-low.

unsupported.load: the sample tube is put in by the lab operator (no load command; the lid and levers are manual)
unsupported.unload: the sample tube is taken out by the lab operator (no unload command)
unsupported.set-temp: its temperatures are method settings (desorb-temp, trap-low, trap-high, valve-temp, line-temp)
unsupported.inject: the desorbed sample goes to the GC by itself once the GC is ready (no manual step)
unsupported.rinse: no rinse step (tube and trap conditioning are method modes: `method mode=tube_condition`)

alternatives.rinse: `chemlab run INST method mode=trap_condition` then `chemlab run INST start`.

start: the run does a leak test, purges, desorbs the tube onto the cold trap, waits for the GC to be ready and then desorbs the trap into the GC
method: method.configure needs every setting; the ones you leave out stay as in the last accepted method, else the documented defaults (the reply lists them); set recollect=false if no re-collection tube is installed

markes_unityxr.manual: UNITY-xr user manual (quick start p.11-14, tube and trap p.15-21, method editor p.25-42)
